from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class InvestmentCashFlow(BaseModel):
    """One company's investment activity cash flow from a single financial report."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name from this financial report")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g., '2024年第一季度'")
    metric_name: str | None = Field(description="The metric name, e.g., '投资活动产生的现金流量净额'")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The cash flow amount value")
    unit_in_text: str | None = Field(description="The original unit in the document, e.g., '元', '百万元'")
    amount_with_unit: str | None = Field(description="The original amount as written in the document with its unit")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    investment_cash_flows: list[InvestmentCashFlow]
